basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Junior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi has invited applications from Indian nationals for project appointment under the project Development of PIJF for security applications. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project whichever is earlier. Eligible candidates can submit their applications by e-mail to Prof. Nirat Ray at [email protected] by 05/11/2026 at 5.00 p.m.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Junior Project Assistant (Tech.) Graduate degree with five years of work experience in project administration/management/support/accounting/documentation/training, etc. Knowledge of research project administration/workflow and experience in coordination with funding agencies and government departments are required. | A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST candidates.

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website of IIT Delhi.
Fill out the form completely with information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division, details of work experience, and Advertisement Number.
Send the duly filled form via e-mail to Prof. Nirat Ray at the email address [email protected].
Mention the advertisement number on the subject line of the email.
Submit the completed application by e-mail on or before 05/11/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

Development of PIJF for security applications. (RM00133G)

content_sections.heading: About IIT Delhi Junior Project Assistant (Tech.)
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Delhi located at Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110016, through its Industrial Research & Development Unit, has announced a project appointment for a Junior Project Assistant (Tech.) position. The appointment supports the research project titled "Development of PIJF for security applications" funded by the Department of Defence Research & Development under the Principal Investigator Prof. Nirat Ray in the Department of Material Science & Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 01 vacancy for the advertised post under the project. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST candidates.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate degree with five years of work experience in project administration/management/support/accounting/documentation/training, etc. Knowledge of research project administration/workflow and experience in coordination with funding agencies and government departments are required.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment shall be on a contractual basis with a consolidated pay slab ranging from Rs. 29,290/- to Rs. 38,220/- p.m. plus HRA @27%, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post. The names of short-listed candidates will be displayed on the web link along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for the online interview. Candidates requiring clarification on eligibility may contact Prof. Nirat Ray via email.

faq.question: Q1. What is the position announced in the IIT Delhi recruitment notice?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi has announced one vacancy for the Junior Project Assistant (Tech.) post under the project Development of PIJF for security applications.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application by email is 05/11/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Project Assistant (Tech.) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree with five years of work experience in project administration, management, support, accounting, documentation, training, and knowledge of research project administration and workflow with government departments.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship is on a pay slab starting from Rs. 29,290/- up to Rs. 38,220/- p.m. plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IIT Delhi IRD website and submit the filled form via email to Prof. Nirat Ray at [email protected] with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on higher criteria set by IIT Delhi, and only short-listed candidates will be called for an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the appointment permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier, up to 29.04.2028.
